# ACPD source snapshot

This directory contains the Apache-2.0 licensed `acpd` and `acpd_io` 0.1.0
runtime packages used by Cockpit Console. The upstream project identifies its
repository as <https://github.com/agentclientprotocol/dart-sdk> but is not
currently available from that URL or pub.dev, so the source required for a
reproducible Console build is kept in this repository.

Only runtime libraries are included. Cockpit does not publish these packages.
See [LICENSE](LICENSE) for the upstream license.
